question: Will Lula win the most votes in the first round of the 2026 Brazil presidential election?
resolution_criteria:
A presidential election is scheduled to take place in Brazil on October 4, 2026.

This market will resolve according to the listed candidate who receives the most valid votes in the first round of this election.

Candidates will be primarily ranked by order of valid votes won. If two or more candidates are tied for any position, ties will be broken by alphabetical order of the candidates’ listed full names as they appear in this market. This market will resolve to the candidate that occupies the highest finishing position after applying this ranking.

If the result of this election isn't known definitively by June 30, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, the market will resolve to "Other".

This market will resolve based on the result of the election, as indicated by a consensus of credible reporting. If there is ambiguity, this market will resolve based solely on the official results as reported by the Brazilian government, specifically the Superior Electoral Court (Tribunal Superior Eleitoral, TSE) (e.g., https://dadosabertos.tse.jus.br/).

# Research report 1 of 2

## Lula and the 2026 Brazil first round: research as of 2026-09-24

The polls available by 2026-09-24 had Lula narrowly ahead in the first round. Lula's lead over Flávio Bolsonaro was 2 to 4 points, close to the margins of error. Polymarket had moved in Flávio's favour for the overall election from 11 September. I found no first-round market price.

### 1. Resolution source
- The outcome is decided by the official TSE results (dadosabertos.tse.jus.br) or a consensus of credible reporting. The first round is on 2026-10-04, so no results existed by 2026-09-24. I did not fetch the TSE portal because it would not show anything yet.

### 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the question yet. Every poll I found from on or before 2026-09-24 shows Lula leading Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), but within or close to the margin of error.

### 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-09-24: Datafolha (2,002 interviews, 22-23 Sept, registered as BR-00304/2026, margin ±2) had Lula 40%, Flávio 36%, Augusto Cury 5%, Ronaldo Caiado 4%, Renan Santos 3%, Romeu Zema 1%. Blank, null or none was 5% and undecided 2%. Datafolha's previous poll (17 Sept) had Lula 39%, Flávio 36%. Most reports put the runoff at Lula 47%, Flávio 45%. This poll may have come out after the forecast closed at 03:40 UTC. [Jornal Opção](https://www.jornalopcao.com.br/ultimas-noticias/datafolha-lula-tem-40-e-flavio-bolsonaro-36-no-1o-turno-871618/), [SBT News](https://sbtnews.sbt.com.br/noticia/politica/datafolha-lula-tem-40-contra-36-de-flavio-no-1-turno)
- 2026-09-22 (approximate): an AtlasIntel/Bloomberg poll had Lula 45.8%, Flávio 43.4% in the first round and a runoff of 47.7% to 47.4%. Bloomberg Línea called it a technical tie. I could not confirm the exact release date. [Itatiaia](https://www.itatiaia.com.br/politica/eleicoes/atlas-bloomberg-flavio-bolsonaro-cresce-e-empata-com-lula-em-eventual-2-turno/)
- 2026-09-21: Quaest for Globo (2,004 interviews, 17-20 Sept, margin ±2) had Lula 37%, Flávio 33% in the first round. Lula was up 1 point and Flávio up 2 from Quaest's previous poll. The runoff was tied at about Flávio 42%, Lula 41%. [Brasil de Fato](https://www.brasildefato.com.br/2026/09/21/quaest-lula-vence-no-1o-turno-cenario-de-2o-turno-tem-empate-com-flavio-bolsonaro/)
- Mid-September: an AtlasIntel poll with fieldwork on 11-16 Sept had Flávio slightly ahead in the runoff, 47.2% to 46.8%. [Congresso em Foco / search snippet](https://congressoemfoco.com.br/noticia/120849/atlasintel-lula-abre-9-pontos-sobre-flavio-e-vence-todos-no-2-turno)
- Earlier in 2026: Flávio entered the race in December 2025 with his father's backing. He lost ground in May after audio sent to banker Daniel Vorcaro was released. Flávio denies any wrongdoing. [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/12/6/flavio-bolsonaro-enters-brazils-2026-presidential-race-with-fathers-nod), [O Antagonista](https://oantagonista.com.br/brasil/flavio-cai-13-pontos-no-polymarket-apos-divulgacao-de-audio-enviado-a-vorcaro/)

### 4. Base rates
These are from my own background knowledge. I did not check them against sources in this session.
- The PT candidate topped the first round in 2002, 2006, 2010, 2014 and 2022, and finished second in 2018 behind Jair Bolsonaro.
- 2022: Lula won the first round 48.4% to 43.2%. The final polls overstated his margin, because Bolsonaro outperformed his polling by several points.
- Taken together, Brazilian polls have tended to underestimate the Bolsonaro-aligned candidate. A 2-4 point poll lead is about the size of that past error.

### 5. Other forecasts
- 2026-09-11: Polymarket's overall-election market had Flávio 52.45%, Lula 45.50%. Lula had led in all 120 readings from 14 May to 10 September. [Tribuna do Planalto](https://tribunadoplanalto.com.br/apostas-no-exterior-registram-alta-de-flavio-e-recuo-de-lula-em-setembro/)
- 2026-09-18: Polymarket had Flávio 54.8%, Lula 42.5%. [Tribuna do Planalto](https://tribunadoplanalto.com.br/apostas-no-exterior-registram-alta-de-flavio-e-recuo-de-lula-em-setembro/)
- Late September: Polymarket reportedly had Flávio about 58%, Lula 42%. The exact date is unclear and may be after 2026-09-24. [Revista Oeste](https://revistaoeste.com/politica/flavio-supera-lula-no-polymarket-e-elon-musk-reage/)
- These prices are for winning the presidency, not for topping the first round. I could not find a dated Polymarket, Kalshi or Manifold price for the first-round question. Prediction markets on politics have been banned in Brazil since spring 2026. [Aos Fatos](https://www.aosfatos.org/noticias/pesquisa-flavio-61-intencoes-voto/)

### 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- More Datafolha, Quaest and AtlasIntel polls before 4 October, including final pre-election releases. In the polls above, Flávio has been gaining slightly faster than Lula.
- Late-campaign TV debates. Agência Lupa notes that a debate is shaping the closing themes. [Lupa](https://agencialupa.substack.com/p/13512680_lente-nas-elei-es-8)
- Smaller candidates (Cury, Caiado, Santos, Zema) may lose voters to the two leaders through tactical "useful vote" switching.
- First round on 2026-10-04, with the TSE count published the same night.

# Research report 2 of 2 (written independently)

I'm writing up the findings now. I've only used information dated on or before 2026-09-24.

## 1. Resolution source
- 2026-09-24: The TSE decides the result, through its official results portal (resultados.tse.jus.br) and its open data portal (dadosabertos.tse.jus.br). The first round is on 2026-10-04, so no vote counts exist yet. I could not fetch the TSE pages; they would only have candidate registration data at this point. [TSE open data](https://dadosabertos.tse.jus.br/)
- Under the rules, Lula (PT) resolves YES only if he gets more valid votes than every other candidate, which in practice means Flávio Bolsonaro (PL).

## 2. Current status
- Nothing has settled the question yet. Lula has led every major first-round poll in September, but by only 3 to 7 points, and some leads are close to a technical tie.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-09-22: Quaest (TV Globo/O Globo), fieldwork Sept 17-20, 2,004 interviews, margin of error ±2: Lula 37%, Flávio 33%, Augusto Cury 6%, Ronaldo Caiado 4%, Renan Santos 3%, Romeu Zema 1%, undecided 8%. Runoff: Flávio 42%, Lula 41%. [Movimento Econômico](https://movimentoeconomico.com.br/politica/2026/09/22/quaest-lula-tem-37-e-flavio-bolsonaro-33-e-disputa-segue-empatada-no-2o-turno/), [Diário do Nordeste](https://diariodonordeste.verdesmares.com.br/pontopoder/pesquisa-quaest-lula-tem-37-flavio-33-e-cury-6-1.3793076)
- ~2026-09-17/18: Datafolha: Lula 39%, Flávio 36%, Cury 6%, Caiado 4% of total votes, described as a technical tie. Runoff: Lula 46%, Flávio 44%. [DGABC](https://www.dgabc.com.br/Noticia/4347629/datafolha-no-1-turno-lula-tem-39-dos-votos-totais-flavio-36-cury-6-caiado-4-), [Folha PE](https://www.folhape.com.br/politica/datafolha-no-1o-turno-lula-tem-39-dos-votos-totais-flavio-36/513344/)
- 2026-09-14/15: Quaest: Lula 36%, Flávio 31%. Flávio leads the runoff by a small, numerical-only margin. [O Povo](https://mais.opovo.com.br/jornal/politica/2026/09/15/pesquisa-quaest-lula-lidera-no-1-turno-mas-flavio-aparece-numericamente-a-frente-no-2.html)
- ~2026-09-11: Datafolha: Lula 39%, Flávio 35%. In valid votes, Lula 42% and Flávio 37%. [Diário do Nordeste](https://diariodonordeste.verdesmares.com.br/pontopoder/pesquisa-datafolha-lula-tem-39-de-intencao-de-voto-no-1-turno-e-flavio-bolsonaro-35-1.3790986), [Jornal Opção](https://www.jornalopcao.com.br/ultimas-noticias/datafolha-flavio-encosta-em-lula-e-reduz-diferenca-para-4-pontos-no-1o-turno-867273/)
- ~2026-09-07: Quaest: Lula 36%, Flávio 29%, Cury 8%. Runoff tied at 41% each. [Diário de Pernambuco](https://www.diariodepernambuco.com.br/politica/2026/09/11723294-quaest-lula-tem-36-e-flavio-29-no-primeiro-turno-cury-aparece-com-8.html)
- ~2026-09-03: Datafolha: Lula 38%, Flávio 33%, Cury 8%, Caiado 4%. [Jornal Opção](https://www.jornalopcao.com.br/ultimas-noticias/datafolha-lula-tem-38-contra-33-de-flavio-diferenca-cai-a-cinco-pontos-no-1o-turno-864875/)
- ~2026-09-02: Quaest: Lula 37%, Flávio 30%, Cury 10%. [CNN Brasil](https://www.cnnbrasil.com.br/eleicoes/quaest-lula-tem-37-no-1o-turno-flavio-30-e-cury-10/)
- 2026-08-31: AtlasIntel/Bloomberg (Aug 25-30, n=5,014): first round Lula 43.4%, Flávio 33.7%, Cury 7.8%, Renan Santos 7.6%. Runoff: Lula 47.1%, Flávio 42.6%. [Reuters via Internazionale](https://www.internazionale.it/ultime-notizie-reuters/2026/08/31/lula-s-lead-narrows-in-potential-brazil-presidential-runoff-atlasintel-bloomberg-poll-shows)
- Trend: Lula's first-round lead has narrowed during September, from about 7 points to 3-4 points, while Flávio has gained.

## 4. Base rates
- The PT candidate came first in the first round in 2002, 2006, 2010, 2014 and 2022. In 2018 Jair Bolsonaro came first.
- 2022: Lula got 48.4% of valid votes and Jair Bolsonaro 43.2%. The final polls had underestimated Bolsonaro by several points, while Lula's share was close to the polls. [Wikipedia 2022](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2022_Brazilian_general_election)
- A sitting president running for re-election has come first in the first round every time: 1998, 2006, 2014 and 2022 (Bolsonaro was second in 2022 as incumbent, so this held in 3 of 4).
- In September 2026, Lula's lead in the polls (3-5 points in Datafolha and Quaest) is smaller than the polling error on the right-wing candidate in 2022.

## 5. Other forecasts
- The sources I found cover Polymarket's overall election-winner market, not a first-round market. Lula led that market until 2026-09-10 (about 52% vs 45.5%). Flávio took the lead on 2026-09-11 and had kept it as of the latest reports. Late August had Lula around 55%. [Times Brasil](https://timesbrasil.com.br/eleicoes-2026/decisao-2026-flavio-dispara-no-mercado-de-apostas-e-chega-a-reta-final-da-eleicao-com-75-de-probabilidade-de-vitoria/), [Revista Oeste](https://revistaoeste.com/politica/flavio-supera-lula-no-polymarket-e-elon-musk-reage/)
- July 2026: Polymarket had Lula at 63% and Flávio at 23.8% to win. [BNL Data](https://bnldata.com.br/en/apostas-na-eleicao-de-2026-somam-r-103-mi-no-polymarket-e-lula-lidera-com-53/)
- I could not find a price for the first-round "most votes" market, or any Kalshi or Manifold numbers dated on or before 2026-09-24.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- New Datafolha, Quaest and AtlasIntel polls are expected weekly, with final polls on the eve of the vote, 2026-10-03.
- The final TV debates are expected, including the traditional TV Globo debate in the week before the vote. I did not confirm its date.
- Votes for third-party candidates such as Cury, Caiado and Renan Santos may shift to the top two at the last minute ("voto útil"), which could narrow or widen the gap.
- 2026-10-04: first round. The TSE count is usually decided on election night.

**(e) Scenarios.**
- No: Right-leaning minor-candidate voters consolidate behind Flávio in the final week and polls again miss part of the Bolsonaro vote. Flávio finishes at about 45% of valid votes to Lula's 44%.
- Yes: Pollsters have largely corrected their 2022 problems and Lula holds his stable base of about 44 to 46% of valid votes. Minor candidates keep enough of their vote that Flávio falls 1 to 3 points short.

**(f) From base rate to final.** I start at about 67% for a 3-point poll leader. I then subtract for the systematic underestimation of the right (about 2 points of expected margin), the adverse trend, and likely tactical consolidation toward Flávio. That leaves an expected margin of roughly Lula +0.5 to +1, with an error spread of about 5 points, which implies about 55%. The overall-winner market favouring Flávio is consistent with this, since runoff polls are tied while first-round polls still favour Lula by about 3 points. I see this as slightly better than a coin flip for Lula.

Probability: 54%
